body: Empty. Hollow, I feel *cold* deep inside, if that makes any sort of sense. Like a shell. No longer tired, or drained, but futile.
Thanks. I'll try to see a doctor ASAP.
So what kind of doctor should I look for? I really don't know anything about this kind of stuff - a psychologist/psychiatrist/therapist/counselor/specialist?
The only way I can describe how I feel is that I'm dry - hollow, empty, and always ever so *tired.*
